plan: A minotaur support who knocks enemies up and tanks everything thanks to his ultimate.
aSurveiller: His W then Q combo. He pushes you with his headbutt then knocks you up: don't stand alone in front of your allies.
contrer: Stay away from him at level 2: his combo (W then Q) can get you killed.
During his R he takes almost no damage: focus another target.
Keep your distance: he has to be in melee range to act.
forces: Lots of crowd control: knock up, knock back, stun.
faiblesses: Must be in melee range to act.
His spells have long cooldowns early on.

sorts.P: Heals himself and allies by disabling enemies.
sorts.Q: Slams the ground and knocks up.
sorts.W: Charges a target and knocks it back.
sorts.E: Tramples; after several hits, his next attack stuns.
sorts.R: Removes crowd control and massively reduces damage taken.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 2, at any point in the game.
